name: AKTOR Group
note: AKTOR Anonymi Etaireia Symmetochon, Technikon kai Energeiakon Ergon (AKTOR Group), formerly Intrakat - listed on the Athens Stock Exchange (ticker AKTR). Largest shareholder Winex Investments Limited, a legal entity related to chairman/CEO Alexandros Exarchou: 33.41% of voting rights after the July 2026 capital increase (newmoney.gr reporting the company's ATHEX announcement).
